description: Health check for this deliberation install: config validity (config/config.schema.json), provider CLIs and keys (codex, agy, XAI_API_KEY, OpenRouter key, local providers), sessions/debug flags, the host tool-call cap, the session store dir and, when `shellSessionsDir` is passed, path drift between your shell and this server. Local and read-only: stat/env probes plus `codex --version`, no provider API calls, no login, writes nothing. Returns a text-wrapped JSON envelope { findings[] (check, status ok|warn|fail|info, message, fix?), summary, paths }. The `/deliberation:doctor` slash command renders this for humans.

shellSessionsDir.description: Optional: the session store dir your shell resolves (DELIBERATION_SESSIONS, else $XDG_CACHE_HOME or ~/.cache, then deliberation/sessions). When set, doctor reports drift against the dir this server uses.

name: doctor
